decks.notes: This Rakdos Aggro deck aims to quickly and aggressively dominate the opponent by playing powerful creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester, Bonecrusher Giant, and Graveyard Trespasser. It also includes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize, Dreadbore, and Fatal Push to control the opponent's board. The deck leverages the powerful planeswalker Chandra, Torch of Defiance for additional value and burn damage. With a mix of efficient removal, powerful threats, and disruptive elements, this deck seeks to pressure the opponent and close out the game quickly.

The deck focuses on utilizing graveyard synergy and self-mill cards to quickly fill the graveyard with creatures. By combining Greasefang's ability to create Spirit tokens with the powerful Parhelion II, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of tokens. The inclusion of Thoughtseize allows for disruption of the opponent's game plan, while Witherbloom Command and Can't Stay Away provide additional graveyard recursion and control options. The deck's mana base is designed to support the color requirements of the cards while maximizing consistency.

This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast, aggressive creatures and burn spells, dealing damage quickly and efficiently. The key strategy is to maintain pressure on the opponent while utilizing cards like Chandra, Dressed to Kill and Light Up the Stage for card advantage. Eidolon of the Great Revel punishes opponents for casting spells, and cards like Bonecrusher Giant and Skewer the Critics provide removal options. The mana base is focused on providing consistent red mana for casting spells and activating abilities, with lands like Den of the Bugbear and Ramunap Ruins supporting the aggressive game plan.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal, and card draw, using powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. It also includes board wipes like Supreme Verdict and a win condition in Shark Typhoon. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value and flexibility in card choices. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while establishing a solid control of the board and card advantage through its powerful spells and card draw.

This Rakdos Sacrifice deck focuses on quickly sacrificing creatures like Cauldron Familiar and Voldaren Epicure to trigger effects such as Mayhem Devil's ping ability and Witch's Oven's token generation. It uses cards like Claim the Firstborn and Fatal Push for removal, along with Shrapnel Blast for additional reach. Experimental Synthesizer and Oni-Cult Anvil provide card advantage and help maintain pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes utility lands like Castle Locthwain and Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance to support the aggressive game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly flood the battlefield with cheap, efficient creatures and overwhelm the opponent with a fast, aggressive strategy. With a focus on low-cost creatures like Adeline, Resplendent Cathar and Thalia's Lieutenant, this deck aims to build a wide board presence and pump up its creatures with cards like Brave the Elements. The use of cards like Soldier of the Pantheon and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben helps to disrupt the opponent's game plan while applying pressure. Wedding Announcement and Castle Ardenvale provide additional ways to generate creature tokens for added aggression.

This deck focuses on utilizing sacrifice effects to generate value and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By sacrificing creatures like Cauldron Familiar and Bloodtithe Harvester with Witch's Oven and Deadly Dispute, the deck can trigger abilities like Mayhem Devil and Village Rites to deal damage to the opponent and draw cards. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Claim the Firstborn while also applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger. Jegantha, the Wellspring provides additional mana fixing and a powerful companion option.

The focal point of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with instants and sorceries in order to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard for increased aggression. Utilizing cards like Chart a Course, Pieces of the Puzzle, and Treasure Cruise to draw cards and fill the graveyard, along with cheap removal spells like Fiery Impulse and Lightning Axe to control the board. The inclusion of Thing in the Ice provides an alternate win condition if the Phoenix strategy is disrupted. The key strategy is to quickly fill the graveyard, bring back Phoenix, and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays.

This deck focuses on sacrificing creatures to trigger powerful effects, generating incremental advantage while applying pressure on the opponent. By utilizing cards like Cauldron Familiar, Witch's Oven, and Mayhem Devil, the deck aims to control the board and deal damage to the opponent through sacrifice synergies. Korvold, Fae-Cursed King is a key piece of the deck, allowing for card draw and additional benefits whenever a permanent is sacrificed. With an aggressive game plan and strong synergy between its cards, this Jund Aggro deck looks to overwhelm opponents with a relentless onslaught of sacrifices and damage.

The main concept of the deck is to build a fast and aggressive board presence with low mana cost creatures and pump effects like Luminarch Aspirant and Thalia's Lieutenant. This Aggro - Weenie White deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of creatures, while protecting them with cards like Brave the Elements. The inclusion of cards like Adeline, Resplendent Cathar and Pyre of Heroes provides additional synergy and versatility to maintain pressure on the opponent. The mana base is optimized for consistency and allows for activating Mutavault and Shefet Dunes for additional value.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively utilize Arclight Phoenix as a recurring threat while efficiently cycling through the deck with card draw spells like Treasure Cruise and Pieces of the Puzzle. Ledger Shredder helps to mill cards while also enabling the phoenix's revival. The inclusion of Temporal Trespass allows for explosive turns, while Galvanic Iteration can create additional card advantage. The deck also includes disruption with cards like Strangle and Lightning Axe, as well as protection with Spell Pierce. Hall of Storm Giants provides a powerful finisher option.

The deck focuses on enchantment-based creatures with auras to quickly buff them up and overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like All That Glitters, Ethereal Armor, and Gryff's Boon, the creatures become powerful threats that can deal massive amounts of damage. Light-Paws, Emperor's Voice and Illuminator Virtuoso provide additional support and card draw. The deck also includes protection with cards like Selfless Savior and Generous Visitor. The lands are focused on producing white mana to ensure the deck can consistently play its enchantments and creatures.

This deck is built around using aggressive tactics to quickly overpower the opponent with creatures like Bonecrusher Giant, Graveyard Trespasser, and Bloodtithe Harvester. It also includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Duress to control the opponent's hand and prevent them from stabilizing. The deck also features powerful planeswalkers like Chandra, Torch of Defiance and Sorin the Mirthless to provide additional threats and card advantage. The mana base is carefully crafted to support the aggressive strategy while still allowing for flexibility in casting spells.

The main concept of this Aggro Azorius Tempo deck is to quickly put pressure on the opponent with a combination of spirit creatures and tempo spells. By playing efficient creatures like Ascendant Spirit and Supreme Phantom, alongside disruptive cards like Mausoleum Wanderer and Rattlechains, the deck aims to control the board while dealing consistent damage. Curious Obsession provides card advantage, while Geistlight Snare and Lofty Denial help protect the creatures and maintain tempo advantage. Faceless Haven can also provide a solid finisher option, with the deck focusing on snow-covered Islands for its mana base.

This deck focuses on aggressively sacrificing creatures and using effects triggered by sacrificing to control the board and drain the opponent's life. The key strategy involves using cards like Mayhem Devil and Witch's Oven to repeatedly sacrifice Cauldron Familiar and other creatures, dealing damage to the opponent and gaining incremental advantage. The deck also aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan by removing key threats with cards like Fatal Push and Claim the Firstborn. Jegantha, the Wellspring is utilized as a companion to provide additional value and flexibility.

The main focus of this deck is to aggressively control the tempo of the game by consistently putting pressure on the opponent with a mixture of evasive spirit creatures and efficient instant speed spells. By leveraging powerful synergies between cards like Supreme Phantom and Ascendant Spirit, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of threats while disrupting their game plan with counterspells and bounce effects. The inclusion of Curious Obsession provides additional card advantage to fuel the aggressive strategy, making it difficult for opponents to stabilize against the relentless assault.
